title: Eggplant Bharta
description: A popular Indian dish made by mashing eggplant and mixing it with spices. This recipe is a variation of the classic Bharta.
instructions: 1. Roast the eggplant over an open flame or in the oven until charred and soft.
2. Let the eggplant cool down, then peel and mash it in a bowl.
3. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion, garlic, and green chilies until the onion is translucent.
4. Add the Indian spices and sauté for 1 minute.
5. Add the roasted eggplant to the pan and mash it with a spoon until well combined with the spice mixture.
6. Add salt and lemon juice to taste.
